start.text: Hello, traveler! It's wonderful to see you in Ponyville. Is there anything I can help you with?

choices.text: Do you have any rare information? (once)

about_town.text: Ponyville is the most wonderful town in all of Equestria! Founded by Earth Ponies, it has grown into a place where all kinds of ponies live together in harmony.

rare_info.text: Ah, since you're asking... there are rumors of a hidden gem in the Everfree Forest. But be careful — nopony who went looking ever came back the same.

choices.text: I'll keep that in mind. Thanks!
